title: Build an HTTP request step by step
description: HttpRequest is an immutable object that needs a method and URL at minimum, plus optional headers and a body. A skeleton HttpRequestBuilder exists but its setter methods and build() are unimplemented. Fill them in so callers can chain calls and get a valid HttpRequest back.
hints: Each setter should store the value and return 'this' so calls can be chained
build() should throw IllegalStateException if method or url is null or blank
HttpRequest is a plain data class — you don't need to change it
issues: Constructing an HttpRequest with many optional fields leads to telescoping constructors or a bloated parameter list
There is no validation step before the object is handed to callers
overallGoal: Use the Builder pattern to construct an HttpRequest incrementally, validating required fields only at build() time and keeping HttpRequest itself immutable.
goals: Each HttpRequestBuilder setter returns 'this' to allow method chaining
build() throws IllegalStateException when method or url is missing
The returned HttpRequest is fully populated with whatever was set
